info.title: Learning Path Engine
info.description:
## SCI-PATH Learning Path Engine

Curriculum-ordered lessons, teacher-approved content, progress, media, and AR.

**Swagger lists major integration APIs only** (student path, progress, curriculum, analytics profile, teacher generate/publish). Other routes still work at runtime.

### Cross-service: student name & grade
Fetch identity from User Management: `GET http://localhost:8001/students/{student_id}` → `{ student_id, full_name, grade }`.

### Current lesson being taught
- `GET /lesson/current?user_id=…` → **lesson_id**, **grade**, **chapter_number**, title, resume step
- Add `include_content=true` to also return published **lesson_text** (learning material)
- `POST /lesson` with `{ user_id, lesson_id, profile? }` → full learning material for that chapter
- `GET /lesson/{lesson_id}/media` → YouTube + summary for the chapter
- `GET /progress?user_id=…` → path position + stored grade/profile

Lesson ids look like `g6_sci_03` (grade 6, chapter 3). Interactive docs: `/docs` · `/redoc`

200.description: Returns lesson_id, grade, chapter_number, topic_id. With include_content=true also returns published lesson_text.

post.description:
Learner Profile Analytics → store basic | intermediate | advanced (legacy aliases ok) directly.
Student lesson loads use stored profile when use_stored_mastery=true.

schema.title: Response Get Analytics Profile Analytics Profile  User Id  Get

post.summary: Load learning material for a chapter (lesson_id + grade/chapter in response)
post.description:
Student path: load teacher-approved content for grade chapter + knowledge level.
Profile comes from request category or stored learner profile (basic/intermediate/advanced).
Falls back to any published profile for that chapter when exact match is missing.
Does not generate unless STUDENT_ALLOW_GENERATE=true (dev escape hatch).

Response includes `lesson_id`, `grade`, `chapter_number`, and `lesson_text`.

post.summary: Generate chapter preview (not saved until publish)
post.description: Teacher generates a preview from Chroma + LLM. Not saved until publish.

Identity + optional learning material for the lesson currently being taught.
Use `include_content=true` to attach published `lesson_text`.

use_stored_mastery.description: When true, use stored learner profile (basic/intermediate/advanced) if not sent.

LessonRequest.title: LessonRequest

chapter_number.description: 1-based chapter number within the grade path.

status.title: Status
status.description: ready | unavailable — student only learns when ready.

LessonResponse.title: LessonResponse

url.title: Url
url.description: YouTube watch, share, shorts, or embed URL

MasteryScoreResponse.title: MasteryScoreResponse
MasteryScoreResponse.description: Legacy response shape; use profile field, ignore score/thresholds.

ProgressResponse.title: ProgressResponse
ProgressResponse.description: Learner position on the ordered curriculum path.

lesson_id.title: Lesson Id
lesson_id.description: Required for most actions; optional for set_grade.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0..1 for record_quiz; if >= server threshold, lesson is marked complete and path advances.

step_index.title: Step Index
step_index.description: Current step/page index in lesson stage for resume support.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: Learner grade (6–9). Used by set_grade; also stored on set_current when lesson implies a grade.

topic_id.title: Topic Id
topic_id.description: Filter metadata topic_id. Accepts Assessment IDs (G6_S3_WAT_RESOUR), sibling skills, legacy (g6_science_ch03), or lesson_id.

lesson_id.title: Lesson Id
lesson_id.description: If set (and topic_id omitted), resolves topic_id from curriculum.

SearchRequest.description: Try retrieval without the LLM — proves Chroma + PDF ingest work.
